headline: AI Backlash Grows: Surveillance, Bubble Fears, and Worker Harms
summary: A broad wave of skepticism—covering surveillance, job loss, corporate power, and financial bubbles—dominates reactions, with few voices expressing optimism about AI's trajectory.
